nom: Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Sunscreen Stick SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the stick feels sheer/lightweight and non-greasy for most, though a couple note it is not ideal for oily skin and one still gets oily/splotchy by end of day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the formula as creamy, comfortable and non-greasy, though one reviewer with healing/flaky dry skin found it did not hydrate and left flakes visible.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it does not look cakey or greasy and controls the T-zone reasonably well through the day.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin most often report no irritation, redness or stinging and call it gentle and fragrance-free, but one reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin rejected it outright over white cast and stickiness.
segments.mature: One reviewer references using it on hands to address visible aging, but no dedicated mature-skin feedback is given beyond that.

concerns.aging: Only incidental mention: one reviewer notes applying it to hands to prevent age-related sun damage, and another reports slight fading of sun spots with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe it as non-drying, but one reviewer using it while her skin was healing found it did not moisturize and dry flakes remained visible through the product.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report it does not irritate or redden the skin, including under eyes and on eczema-prone or reactive skin.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers with reactive or eczema-prone skin, or recovering from an allergic reaction, report no flare-ups and easy tolerance; none report barrier damage.
concerns.spots: Only one mention, noting slight fading of sun spots over time; no other reviewer discusses pigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no new breakouts and describe it as non-comedogenic even on acne-prone skin; no reviewer reports it directly causing breakouts, though one acne-prone reviewer disliked the product for texture/cast reasons unrelated to breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say it is not greasy and some say it controls shine under makeup, but a couple with oily skin note it is not ideal for oily skin or that oiliness still returns by day's end.

aspects.libelle: Difficult to twist or apply when hard/cold

extraits.texte: I bought this product and had high hopes for it because I love Cetaphil/have sensitive, acne-prone skin, but this product is just not good. I did a patch test on my skin for three days before applying it all over my face, and I have to say, this did NOT make me break out which is great! But as soon as I applied the sunscreen to my whole face, I quickly realized there was a terrible white cast all over. I decided to blend it in with my fingers which helped a little, but the sunscreen still felt so thick and sticky. I kept it on though because I knew it wouldn't make me break out and I needed reapplication of sunscreen. So far, I wasn't loving the product, but I didn't hate it. I liked how easy it was to use and how small it was for travel. However, when I went home to wash the sunscreen off, I was disappointed. I first used Cetaphil face wash to try and wash it off, but the sticky white sunscreen was not budging. It was just smudging all over my face the more I washed. I didn't want to scrub my face too hard so I continued to put more and more water on my face but this didn't help. I ended up having to use my makeup remover to remove all the sunscreen off of my face and even then, I had to wash my face a couple of times to ensure that all the stickiness came off. Extremely disappointed because I would love to have a product that I can swipe on my face for reapplication without using my fingers (for when I don't have access to a sink to wash my hands with).

This product is a sheer mineral sunscreen stick with spf 50 UV protection. With darker skin you can see the white caste you get associated with mineral sunscreen so it's not actually sheer. Rubbing it in helps but it still has the purple tint until you've had prolonged sun exposure and at that point it's time to reapply. This productive is convenient small packaging which makes it useful when you're on the go. Probably better dor lighter /fairer skin

I have purchase this twice already. It protects my skin during the summer. I had to repurchase even tho I have tons of face sunscreens. Some ingredients aren't good especially if you are trying to conceive so I had to go back to this one. Zinc oxide is safe for expectant mothers so I had to go back to this one. Only thing tho it's a bit oily and leaves a bit of a white cast. Other than that I really enjoy it.

picked this up on a whim since it was on sale at my drugstore. I've never use the Sun stick before but have always wanted to try it. This is a mineral sunscreen with 6% titanium dioxide and 4.7% zinc oxide. It does have a very, very slight white tint when you first put it on, but it easily rubs in. I would say the finish after you rub it in is a satin finish. It's definitely not greasy, but I wouldn't quite say it's Matte. I had a bad allergic reaction to something so I switched to all gentle skin care and minimal mineral sunscreens and this hasn't broken me out or caused any reaction while my skin is healing. The stick is a nice way to reapply while you're out and about or at the beach, but I haven't tried it over make up. I think it definitely would powder heavy foundation so I wouldn't use it for that. it has no smell and once I put it on, I actually kind of forget about it. It doesn't seem to get greasy through the day. But since my skin is healing, it has been flaky and dry and it definitely doesn't leave grease or hydrate, particularly as the flakes are still visible when I use this sunscreen versus a lotion type. But now that my skin is a bit more healed, the sunscreen looks great. for the price good buy! ￼￼

It's my first time using a sunscreen stick. I was impressed by the formula. I have very sensitive skin but it did not break my out or leave my skin looking red. I also have oily skin and this formula did not make my skin look more oily which is great. Usually sunscreens leave my skin oily. My only complaint is that the application wasn't the best. It was hard to apply, it didn't apply very smooth and left white marks.
This is a very creamy formula in spite of it being a bar. Not greasy (I have dry skin) and very comfortable. Not scented which I love. I totally recommend it! Very convenient for when on the go

extraits.titre: this is my new go- to!
extraits.texte: I started using the cetaphil sheer stick this week, and I'm so impressed with it. I've tried so many different brands that worked, but they were pricey, but left me feely greasy or heavy. This doesn't do that! I have dry/combo skin. Usually by the end of the day I'm oily/splotchy in my t-zone. Not with cetaphil sheer! I'm happy to report that it feels amazing, and it isn't detectible on my skin, and has no scent like my other "higher end" brands. They worked but always left me feeling greasy, heavy, had a scent,etc. Cetaphil sheer stick doesn't do that. It worth trying beautiful people! I can't wait to try some others from this this new line. The stick is easy to glide across your hands and chest as well. Don't forget to use your spf, and don't skin your hands! We show our age all over but you can definitely tell your age in your hand, so don't leave those out. We have to wash our hands a lot these days, so pulling out my stick and reapplying is very convenient!
